Interface TargetJvmVersion

public interface TargetJvmVersion
Represents the target version of a Java library or platform. The target level is expected to correspond to a Java platform version number (integer). For example, "5" for Java 5, "8" for Java 8, or "11" for Java 11.
Since:
5.3
